President Murmu Approves High Court Bench for Ladakh

President Droupadi Murmu has approved the establishment of a High Court bench in Ladakh. This decision follows the Ladakh High Court order dated March 26, 2024, which mandated the creation of the bench. The new regulation will bring judicial services closer to the residents of Ladakh, impacting the region's legal landscape.
